scope: credential-free model catalog adapter drift counts
change: Verified catalog comparisons expose deterministic per-adapter counts for additions, removals and changed models before and after adapter migration, alongside the existing adapter-to-model identifier mapping.

semantics.added: number of current-catalog models introduced on the adapter
semantics.removed: number of previous-catalog models removed from the adapter
semantics.changedBefore: number of changed models classified by their previous adapter
semantics.changedAfter: number of changed models classified by their current adapter
semantics.migration: one adapter migration contributes to changedBefore on the old adapter and changedAfter on the new adapter
semantics.empty: unchanged and source-revision-only reports expose an empty driftByAdapter object
